C0919.title: Hebei Mobile Device Card Payment Fraud Case
C0919.summary: In October 2021, a mobile device card payment fraud occurred in Hebei. Criminals impersonated a bank and sent phishing SMS messages containing malicious links to cardholders, claiming overdue credit card issues.
